instructions_to_main_agent: 1. The frontend theme MUST be pure dark mode (#0A0A0B base) with rich deep obsidian panels, #E63B48 crimson active accents, and warm off-white #F5F3EF text. Never make it look like generic grey SaaS.
2. Install and initialize Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling on the cinematic homepage.
3. Implement the FastAPI backend routes in backend/routers/community.py and backend/routers/waitlist.py for handling community ideas and early access waitlist stored in MongoDB.
5. Use standard shadcn components (Sheet, Button, Dialog, Tabs, Badge, Input, Textarea, Select) styled to match the dark luxury editorial aesthetic.
6. Include data-testid on every interactive element, submission button, tab, and card.
